eyebrow.zh: 离线可跑 · 零 API key · CI 就绪
eyebrow.en: Runs offline · zero API key · CI-ready

headline.zh:
把『换完模型才发现工具调坏』
提前成切换前的一次红灯
headline.en:
Turn 'tool-calls broke after the swap'
into a red light before you switch

sub.zh: 用同一份工具套件分别打五家国产模型的 /chat/completions，把每家吐 tool_calls 的形状归一化成契约快照，逐字段比对，漂移即非零退出——直接挂进 CI。
sub.en: Send one tool suite to each Chinese model's /chat/completions, normalize every tool_calls shape into a contract snapshot, diff field-by-field, and exit non-zero on drift — drop it straight into CI.

title.zh: 切换前红灯，而不是上线后才发现
title.en: A red light before the swap, not a breakage in production

body.zh: 换模型最怕的是 function-calling 静默坏掉——agent 跑到一半才发现某个工具不调用了。ToolDrift 把这条检测提前到 CI：契约一变就红灯、非零退出，挡住一次有问题的迁移。
body.en: The scariest part of a model swap is function-calling breaking silently — you only find out mid-agent that a tool stopped firing. ToolDrift moves that check into CI: the moment the contract changes, it red-lights and exits non-zero, blocking a bad migration.

chips: › 逐字段比对 tool_calls 形状

title.zh: 精确指出哪一处变了，而不是笼统报错
title.en: Pinpoints the exact field that changed, not a vague failure

body.zh: arguments 从 JSON 字符串变成对象、参数键被丢或改名、并行调用数变了、finish_reason 取值不同——每一处漂移都列出字段、旧值→新值、为什么这会让调用方崩。
body.en: arguments flipping from a JSON string to an object, an argument key dropped or renamed, parallel-call count shifting, finish_reason landing on a different value — every drift lists the field, old→new value, and why that breaks a downstream caller.

chips: › 参数键 / 类型 / 并行数

title.zh: 零 API key 也能先看到红绿
title.en: See red/green with zero API keys

body.zh: 拿不到五家的 key 也不卡住：所有命令支持 --from-fixtures，回放离线样本就能演示一次 DeepSeek→通义的契约漂移，十分钟装好即见红绿。
body.en: No keys for all five? Not blocked: every command supports --from-fixtures, replaying offline samples to demo a DeepSeek→Qwen contract drift — install in ten minutes and see red/green.

chips: › 跨五家 Markdown 对比表

title.zh: 一份契约文件锁定期望，每次回归对账
title.en: Pin the expected contract once, regress every swap against it

body.zh: 在 contract.yaml 里写死期望的 tool_calls 形状，每次切换都把实测契约和它对账；还能输出机器可读的 JSON diff，喂给 CI 和未来的漂移看板。
body.en: Pin the expected tool_calls shape in a contract.yaml and reconcile every swap against it; also emit a machine-readable JSON diff to feed CI and a future drift-watch board.

headline.zh: 下次换模型前，先跑一次
headline.en: Before the next model swap, run it once

sub.zh: 一条命令，把 function-calling 漂移提前成切换前的红灯。
sub.en: One command turns function-calling drift into a red light before the switch.
